## Hunt for Additional Indicators

Take action on the analysis above.

First check if dream-me[.]com is used maliciously.

You can't tell via urlscan. You'll need to check via Any Run submissions.
https://app.any.run/submissions
https://app.any.run/tasks/ef4675d6-9792-4a27-adfa-c3be244ddcde

^ winscp[.]id. We've found a WinSCP-themed lure delivering Oyster. 

Perform a cursory glance.

Check winscp[.]id in urlscan.

https://urlscan.io/search/#winscp.id
https://urlscan.io/result/01992f06-6e3a-764c-983f-f4e2a7a839c7/

Observe the "download12.js" file: https://urlscan.io/responses/0b58a544d5e0323bd910dceebe311ab1c1df098c63b4bfca0399a9d83dd762f6/

It contains the following Dynamic Delivery Domains (apiUrls):

dream-me[.]com
msaonl[.]com
ncvalor[.]com
newfrontieradvisorsllc[.]com
newhampshirehomebuyer[.]com

Success!

We add the new indicators to the Indicator Table after we include this section as a source in the Source Table.
